entries.name: if
entries.doc:
Evaluates test. If not the singular values nil or false,
  evaluates and yields then, otherwise, evaluates and yields else. If
  else is not supplied it defaults to nil.

entries.name: assoc-in
entries.doc:
Associates a value in a nested associative structure, where ks is a
  sequence of keys and v is the new value and returns a new nested structure.
  If any levels do not exist, hash-maps will be created.

entries.name: distinct
entries.doc:
Returns a lazy sequence of the elements of coll with duplicates removed.
  Returns a stateful transducer when no collection is provided.

entries.name: eval
entries.doc: Evaluates the form data structure (not text!) and returns the result.

entries.name: filter
entries.doc:
Returns a lazy sequence of the items in coll for which
  (pred item) returns logical true. pred must be free of side-effects.
  Returns a transducer when no collection is provided.

entries.name: frequencies
entries.doc:
Returns a map from distinct items in coll to the number of times
  they appear.

entries.name: get-in
entries.doc:
Returns the value in a nested associative structure,
  where ks is a sequence of keys. Returns nil if the key
  is not present, or the not-found value if supplied.

entries.name: group-by
entries.doc:
Returns a map of the elements of coll keyed by the result of
  f on each element. The value at each key will be a vector of the
  corresponding elements, in the order they appeared in coll.

entries.name: into
entries.doc:
Returns a new coll consisting of to with all of the items of
  from conjoined. A transducer may be supplied.
  (into x) returns x. (into) returns [].

entries.name: keep
entries.doc:
Returns a lazy sequence of the non-nil results of (f item). Note,
  this means false return values will be included.  f must be free of
  side-effects.  Returns a transducer when no collection is provided.

entries.name: keys
entries.doc: Returns a sequence of the map's keys, in the same order as (seq map).

entries.name: let
entries.doc:
binding => binding-form init-expr
  binding-form => name, or destructuring-form
  destructuring-form => map-destructure-form, or seq-destructure-form

  Evaluates the exprs in a lexical context in which the symbols in
  the binding-forms are bound to their respective init-exprs or parts
  therein.

  See https://clojure.org/reference/special_forms#binding-forms for
  more information about destructuring.

entries.name: map
entries.doc:
Returns a lazy sequence consisting of the result of applying f to
  the set of first items of each coll, followed by applying f to the
  set of second items in each coll, until any one of the colls is
  exhausted.  Any remaining items in other colls are ignored. Function
  f should accept number-of-colls arguments. Returns a transducer when
  no collection is provided.

entries.name: mapcat
entries.doc:
Returns the result of applying concat to the result of applying map
  to f and colls.  Thus function f should return a collection. Returns
  a transducer when no collections are provided

entries.name: max-key
entries.doc:
Returns the x for which (k x), a number, is greatest.

  If there are multiple such xs, the last one is returned.

entries.name: merge-with
entries.doc:
Returns a map that consists of the rest of the maps conj-ed onto
  the first.  If a key occurs in more than one map, the mapping(s)
  from the latter (left-to-right) will be combined with the mapping in
  the result by calling (f val-in-result val-in-latter).

entries.name: min-key
entries.doc:
Returns the x for which (k x), a number, is least.

  If there are multiple such xs, the last one is returned.

entries.name: parse-long
entries.doc:
Parse string of decimal digits with optional leading -/+ and return a
  Long value, or nil if parse fails

entries.name: partition-by
entries.doc:
Applies f to each value in coll, splitting it each time f returns a
   new value.  Returns a lazy seq of partitions.  Returns a stateful
   transducer when no collection is provided.

entries.name: partitionv
entries.doc:
Returns a lazy sequence of vectors of n items each, at offsets step
  apart. If step is not supplied, defaults to n, i.e. the partitions
  do not overlap. If a pad collection is supplied, use its elements as
  necessary to complete last partition upto n items. In case there are
  not enough padding elements, return a partition with less than n items.

entries.name: reduce
entries.doc:
f should be a function of 2 arguments. If val is not supplied,
  returns the result of applying f to the first 2 items in coll, then
  applying f to that result and the 3rd item, etc. If coll contains no
  items, f must accept no arguments as well, and reduce returns the
  result of calling f with no arguments.  If coll has only 1 item, it
  is returned and f is not called.  If val is supplied, returns the
  result of applying f to val and the first item in coll, then
  applying f to that result and the 2nd item, etc. If coll contains no
  items, returns val and f is not called.

entries.name: remove
entries.doc:
Returns a lazy sequence of the items in coll for which
  (pred item) returns logical false. pred must be free of side-effects.
  Returns a transducer when no collection is provided.

entries.name: select-keys
entries.doc: Returns a map containing only those entries in map whose key is in keys

entries.name: slurp
entries.doc:
Opens a reader on f and reads all its contents, returning a string.
  See clojure.java.io/reader for a complete list of supported arguments.

entries.name: sort-by
entries.doc:
Returns a sorted sequence of the items in coll, where the sort
  order is determined by comparing (keyfn item).  If no comparator is
  supplied, uses compare.  comparator must implement
  java.util.Comparator.  Guaranteed to be stable: equal elements will
  not be reordered.  If coll is a Java array, it will be modified.  To
  avoid this, sort a copy of the array.

entries.name: update-in
entries.doc:
'Updates' a value in a nested associative structure, where ks is a
  sequence of keys and f is a function that will take the old value
  and any supplied args and return the new value, and returns a new
  nested structure.  If any levels do not exist, hash-maps will be
  created.

entries.name: update-keys
entries.doc:
m f => {(f k) v ...}

  Given a map m and a function f of 1-argument, returns a new map whose
  keys are the result of applying f to the keys of m, mapped to the
  corresponding values of m.
  f must return a unique key for each key of m, else the behavior is undefined.

entries.name: update-vals
vals
entries.doc: Returns a sequence of the map's values, in the same order as (seq map).

entries.name: when-let
entries.doc:
bindings => binding-form test

  When test is true, evaluates body with binding-form bound to the value of test

entries.name: zipmap
entries.doc: Returns a map with the keys mapped to the corresponding vals.

entries.name: join
entries.doc:
Returns a string of all elements in coll, as returned by (seq coll),
   separated by an optional separator.

entries.name: split
entries.doc:
Splits string on a regular expression.  Optional argument limit is
  the maximum number of parts. Not lazy. Returns vector of the parts.
  Trailing empty strings are not returned - pass limit of -1 to return all.

entries.name: upper-case
entries.doc: Converts string to all upper-case.

entries.name: index
entries.doc:
Returns a map of the distinct values of ks in the xrel mapped to a
  set of the maps in xrel with the corresponding values of ks.

entries.name: rename-keys
entries.doc: Returns the map with the keys in kmap renamed to the vals in kmap

entries.name: union
entries.doc: Return a set that is the union of the input sets
